qualification_digest.description: The qualification digest of the graded artifact (model-work/01, Role Qualification): the SHA-256 over exactly the graded members recorded in configuration; the record is valid only for an artifact with the same qualification digest. Members outside it (count, form, recycling, off-track thresholds and actions, budget_floor_seconds, context_budget_tokens, description) never invalidate the record.

configuration.description: The graded members the qualification digest covers (PM-WORK-6).

harness.description: harness_id of the graded harness (identifiers.adoc, harness_id), an operator-added harness included; worker eligibility of its harness profile gates a launch.

harness_version.description: major.minor of the enrolled harness version; a patch change keeps the record valid.

corpus_revision.description: Revision of the model verification corpus the release ships.

missed_sources.description: The corpus sources the import missed, by name; empty when the grading ran on the complete corpus (model-work/01, Corpus Sources).

forms.description: The measurements per graded form; warm is absent for a zero_tool role.

warm_fresh_gap.description: The largest, over the topics, of the topic's fresh agreement minus its warm agreement in percentage points; null when only one form was graded.

ungraded.description: Items whose judge task closed lost, or whose item task ended for a reason of the runtime (role_unavailable, withdrawn); excluded from the agreement. A record with ungraded > 0 qualifies no form.

judge_check.description: The result of the judge instrument check the grading's judge ran (model-work/01, Judge Instrument Check); absent where no check ran (while the corpus holds no topic judge/), and in every record written before this member existed. It blocks no grading.

checkout.description: Where the item ran (model-work/01, Grading): item_commit for an item of the project's own repository run at its origin commit, current for one run in the project checkout, corpus_context for one run in an empty directory with its own context files.

answer.description: The submitted answer; null when the task closed lost.

score.description: The grade a task of the judge role gave the answer (model-work/01, Role Qualification); 0 when the item task ended without an answer for a reason of the model; ungraded when that judge task closed lost or the item task ended for a reason of the runtime.

total_tokens.description: The tokens the answer used (store-schemas/05, Metrics Store).

agreement.description: Percent of the graded items of the topic (ungraded items excluded) answered right in this form.

constant_baseline.description: The agreement of the best constant answerer over the same items (model-work/01, Constant Baseline); the topic qualifies only when agreement exceeds it by the qualification margin.

thin.description: true when items is below the compiled 20.

topics.description: The agreement per topic. The topics of a role, own and generic, are defined by model-work/01, Corpus Topics of a Role; this object holds exactly the topics that definition gives the role and a topic without items is absent. There is no pooled agreement.

items.description: The graded items of all topics of this form.

total_tokens.description: The tokens the form's items used, unmeasured when an item's are.
